name: VTT-323 (M1973)
armament: Igla/Strela MANPADS or AT-3 ATGM rails on some
protection: Thin welded steel. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Chinese Type 63-derived tracked box hull, five road wheels per side
Small cone turret with twin 14.5 mm KPV
Roof hatches for troop egress, no rear ramp
